definition.episode_end: next fall start or sequence end
definition.recovery: first maximal coarse7 run after fall end and before next fall; that run only
definition.post_fall: fall end until first recovery start
definition.unresolved_episode: post-fall until episode end becomes ignore
definition.after_recovery: background after first recovery run end until next fall
definition.source_no_label: original no_label may receive contextual target inside known episode; no special additional masking
definition.frames: full original sequence, including uncovered window tail
